description: Reads one passage in full by its ID, after search_passages has found it. Use it when a search result was shortened, or when you need the text around a passage: neighbors adds up to 3 passages before and after it from the same page, in document order. Returns { passage, before, after }, each passage with its citation_url. To find passages, use search_passages instead. Read-only; fails if the ID is unknown or its source was removed.

id.description: The id field of a passage from a search result. IDs stay stable across syncs.

neighbors.description: How many passages from the same page to include before and after it, in document order (0-3, default 0).

name: get_passage
title: Read a passage
